summary: Tested new Admin dashboard, abandoned cart capture, updated hero banner, and WhatsApp/address updates. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass — GET /api/admin/orders returns list with required fields; PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id} updates status and persists; invalid id returns 404; POST /api/abandoned-cart upserts (single row per email, total recomputed) and empty items returns {ok:false}; GET /api/admin/abandoned-carts lists; GET /api/admin/stats returns total_orders, paid_orders (<=total), revenue, abandoned_carts. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): Home hero renders new banner image (i7rowu0f_1234.png) as a full-width link to /shop with NO duplicate overlay text; About shows +91 8460067169 linking to https://wa.me/918460067169 and address 'Surat'; Footer whatsapp/address also updated. /admin renders admin-page with 4 stat cards (Total Orders 12, Paid Orders 1, Revenue ₹320, Abandoned Carts 3), orders-table with 12 rows, dropdown status change fires PATCH and updates the row status pill in place, refresh button reloads data, abandoned-carts tab shows the abandoned rows. Checkout email onBlur fires POST /api/abandoned-cart and the entry appears in the Admin Abandoned Carts tab immediately. Shop lists 3 products (regression OK). No runtime console errors on any tested page.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin page (/admin) is intentionally public per the spec — before production, add auth guard/role check; anyone with the URL can list orders/customer emails and change statuses.
Abandoned cart endpoint accepts any email and unbounded items list — consider rate-limiting/size cap to prevent DB spam.
Admin stats loads all orders (up to 2000) into memory to compute — fine for now but use Mongo aggregation ($match+$group) once volume grows.
server.py is one file — as endpoints grow, split into routers (admin.py, payments.py) for maintainability.
test_credentials: None — /admin has no auth by design.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test added 1 abandoned cart (email ac_test_<ts>@example.com) and 1 order via /payments/razorpay/order (TEST Admin). Harmless test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (admin orders/stats, abandoned cart capture, hero, WhatsApp/address) work end-to-end. Playwright can complete everything except the Razorpay hosted iframe. Backend test file for admin/abandoned: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_abandoned.py.
